description_en: Pauses a data synchronization task that is in the Synchronizing state
description_zh: 暂停处于同步中的数据同步作业
kebab_example: aliyun dts suspend-synchronization-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtsmr1q4mc21520000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SuspendSynchronizationJob

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the DescribeSynchronizationJobs operation to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSynchronizationJobs接口查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward.
You can set this parameter to Reverse to pause the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
当数据同步实例的拓扑为双向时，才可以传入Reverse以暂停反向同步链路
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.
